appraisal_events.evidence: Odette, sûre de le voir venir après quelques jours, aussi tendre et soumis qu'avant, lui demander une réconciliation, prenait l'habitude de ne plus craindre de lui déplaire et même de l'irriter et lui refusait, quand cela lui était commode, les faveurs auxquelles il tenait le plus; and when Swann tries to prove he can do without her by staying away, any reply from her at all is enough that il ne pût plus rester sans la voir.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator shows Odette settling into confident control of the relationship, no longer fearing to displease Swann and withholding what he wants most, while Swann's own calculated attempts at independence collapse at the slightest contact from her.

status_effects.explanation: Swann becomes habitually tender and submissive, is refused the favors he cares most about, and cannot sustain his own resolve to stay away once Odette makes any contact.
Odette gains confident leverage, no longer fearing to irritate or displease Swann and controlling the relationship's terms by withholding favors at will.
